correctness.rationale: One-grain overwrite can flip only position j>=1 to its previous bit. For each weight-two support {a,b}, singleton descendants are ∅ for {0,1}, {0} for a=0,b>=2, {b} for a>=1,b=a+1, and {a,b} for a>=1,b>=a+2. Disjoint singleton descendants force at most n codewords, and extremality forces {0,1}, then either all adjacent pairs plus {0,r} with r>=3, or replacement of one adjacent {j−1,j} by {1,j} for j>=4. Pairwise weight-three outputs of these codes are separated by consecutive/nonconsecutive support types. For n>=4 exactly (n−3)² codebooks; n2=1,n3=2. Direct independently constructed collision graphs confirmed optima and full extremizer equality n=2..8.
